cards.title: Prohibition of Default Imputation and Silent Conversion
cards.claim: BLQ data must not be imputed with zero or half-LLOQ by default. Silent conversion of BLQ to missing is prohibited. Substitution of BQL with LOQ/2 has been shown to introduce bias in parameter estimates. Omission of BQL data is also associated with substantial bias. The correct handling (e.g., likelihood-based) is a modeling decision, not an EDA transformation.
conditions: No covariate analysis activation in this assignment.
limitations: Simulation results in source literature depend on tested model forms; do not impose a universal BQL method as project policy.
EDA does not fit models or determine the optimal likelihood method for BQL.
Target drug has NO human PK/PD observations; human methodological examples are not observations for the target drug.
cards.downstream_use: Ensures that downstream model fitting receives raw, unaltered data with explicit censoring flags, allowing the modeler to apply appropriate likelihood methods (e.g., M3/M4) rather than relying on biased imputation.
cards.retrieval_keywords: BLQ, missing, not sampled, technical failure, above-range and assay qualification

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
